title: Yam the Pig
lines: Tom has a pet pig, Yam.
Yam is big. Yam can run.
Tom lets Yam sit on a rug.
But Yam is not fed yet.
Yam runs at a big pot.
The pot tips. Nuts pop up.
Tom is not mad. Tom fed Yam.

questions.ask: Why did Yam run at the pot?
questions.listenFor: Because Yam had not been fed yet. If they say "he was hungry," ask them to find the line that tells us - the word yet is the clue.
Nuts. Have your child find the word nuts on the page and touch it - proving it beats remembering it.

questions.ask: Do you think Yam is a good pet? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer. You want a reason from the story - Yam knocked the pot over, or Yam naps quietly at the end. Tom does not blame Yam; he works out that the pig was hungry. Reasons matter more than the yes or no.
